summary: The global economy in 2026 is undergoing significant transitions driven by technological innovation, geopolitical realignments, and climate challenges. Analysts highlight that while advanced economies are stabilizing after inflationary pressures of the early 2020s, emerging markets are experiencing rapid growth.
